setup: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS db_selftest_a (k TEXT PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS db_selftest_b (k TEXT, v TEXT)
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS db_selftest_v AS SELECT k, v FROM db_selftest_b
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS db_selftest_t AFTER INSERT ON db_selftest_a BEGIN INSERT INTO db_selftest_b VALUES (new.k, new.v); END
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS metrics_calls (t INTEGER NOT NULL, worker TEXT NOT NULL, n INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (t, worker)) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS metrics_faults (t INTEGER NOT NULL, worker TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS library_docs (k TEXT PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT)
statements: INSERT INTO db_selftest_b SELECT k, v FROM db_selftest_a
UPDATE db_selftest_a SET v = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM db_selftest_b)
SELECT t, n FROM metrics_calls WHERE t >= ?1
SELECT c.t, d.v FROM metrics_calls c JOIN library_docs d ON d.k = c.worker
INSERT INTO metrics_faults SELECT t, worker FROM metrics_calls
INSERT INTO metrics_calls (t, worker, n) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3) ON CONFLICT (t, worker) DO UPDATE SET n = n + excluded.n
INSERT INTO metrics_faults SELECT 1, v FROM library_docs
CREATE TABLE metrics_daily (d TEXT PRIMARY KEY, n INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS metrics_calls (t INTEGER)
ALTER TABLE metrics_faults ADD COLUMN ms REAL
